name: HiveMind
notes: Club printouts and slides: example photos of pests and diseases, and of what people mistake for honey bees.
The swarm flyer asks whether the bees are inside something, and explains cutouts.
Several eggs in a cell on its own is now a note, not laying workers: a new queen often does it at first.
Treatment chart: always follow the treatment's own instructions. Sign-in sheet is double-sided.
